# ui::Edges

Header: `winui/core/Geometry.hpp`.

Some edges of a [ui::Thickness](thickness.md) by name, the others 0: `.margin = ui::Edges{.left = 32}`.

Converts to a [Thickness](thickness.md) wherever one is taken.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `left` | `float` | `0.0f` | Left edge, DIPs. |
| `top` | `float` | `0.0f` | Top edge, DIPs. |
| `right` | `float` | `0.0f` | Right edge, DIPs. |
| `bottom` | `float` | `0.0f` | Bottom edge, DIPs. |
